column1: Commander, we of the Illyrian Palatinate don't want to involve embroil ourselves in conflict with you.  Rather than attack us, let us work together for mutual benefit.
column2: 指挥官，我们伊利里亚伯国不想卷入与你的冲突。与其攻打我们，不如为互利而携手合作。

column1: Greetings Commander.  The Illyrian Palatinate has a task requiring a competent lance of mercenaries, can we discuss the details?
column2: 您好，指挥官。伊利里亚伯国有一项任务需要一支能打的雇佣兵小队，我们能否细谈？

column1: Greetings again Commander.  The Illyrian Palatinate once again have a small matter you can assist with, if you would care to help?
column2: 又见面了，指挥官。伊利里亚伯国再次有桩小事可以请你相助，你是否愿意帮忙？

column1: Hello again, friend of the Illyrian Palatinate.  I have a task I would generally not entrust to a mercenary, but I am willing to pay you well to complete it.
column2: 又见面了，伊利里亚伯国的朋友。我有一项平时绝不托付给雇佣兵的任务，但我愿意出重金请你完成。

column1: Greetings my trusted friend.  The Illyrian Palatinate is already indebted to you for your services in the past, so I have saved this choice contract for you if you want it?
column2: 你好，我信赖的朋友。伊利里亚伯国早已因你过去的效力而欠你人情，所以我为你留着这份精选合约，你想要吗？

column1: Well done Commander.  The satisfactory completion of this contract will benefit the Illyrian Palatinate, and we have transferred your c-bills to your account.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。这份合约的圆满完成将惠及伊利里亚伯国，我们已把星币转入你的账户。

column1: Your contract with the Illyrian Palatinate required you to complete the primary objective, not just 'make an attempt'.  In the spirit of good faith, we will provide a partial payment this time, please don't let it happen again.
column2: 你与伊利里亚伯国的合约要求你完成主要目标，而不只是"尝试一下"。本着善意，这次我们会提供部分报酬，请别再让这种事发生。

column1: Factions push at our borders, Rasalhaguan refugees poor in to escape the conflicts, and now I get incompetent mercenary Commanders who can't complete any of the objectives required.  Go away, I have no time for your excuses.
column2: 各势力在边境步步紧逼，拉沙尔哈格难民涌来躲避战火，如今我又要应付连任一目标都完不成的无能雇佣兵指挥官。滚开，我没时间听你辩解。

column1: You have done more to undermine the existence of the St Ives Compact than the Capellan Federation has since we left!  Please reverse this trend by agreeing to this contract.
column2: 你对我们圣艾夫斯协约存续的破坏，比嘉佩兰联邦自我们离开以来做的还多！请接下这份合约，扭转这一局面。

column1: Commander, I am curious as to why you have fought so often against us in the past.  If it was just for money, I can assure you that the St Ives Compact is equally capable of paying for your services, such as for this task.
column2: 指挥官，我很好奇你过去为何屡屡与我们为敌。若只是为了钱，我可以向你保证，圣艾夫斯协约同样付得起你的效力，比如这项任务。

column1: Commander, the St Ives Compact is a friendly place, and I wonder how we got off on the wrong foot.  Let us put the past behind us, and agree to suitable terms for this contract.
column2: 指挥官，圣艾夫斯协约是个友善之地，我不知道我们当初如何起了误会。让我们把过往抛在脑后，就这份合约谈妥合适的条款。

column1: Welcome Commander.  The St Ives Compact requires the services of a competent lance of 'mechs, shall we discuss how you wish to be paid?
column2: 欢迎，指挥官。圣艾夫斯协约需要一支能打的机甲小队效力，我们是否该谈谈你希望如何获酬？

column1: Greetings my friend.  The St Ives Compact appreciates all the help you have given us, and we would like to offer you this contract by way of thanks.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。圣艾夫斯协约感激你给予的所有帮助，特此献上这份合约聊表谢意。

column1: If it's not the Hero of the St Ives Compact!  I trust you like no other, and having said that I have a task I would entrust to no other.  Shall we discuss payment?
column2: 这不是圣艾夫斯协约的英雄吗！我信任你胜过任何人，正因如此，我有件只愿托付给你的任务。我们是否该谈谈报酬？

column1: Thank you for your services Commander.  The St Ives Compact has transferred the agreed payment into your account, and we hope to have further work for you soon.
column2: 感谢你的效力，指挥官。圣艾夫斯协约已把约定好的报酬转入你的账户，我们希望不久后有更多活儿交给你。

column1: Commander, I don't know what happened, but we can't pay you when you completely fail the mission.  I hope this never happens again, for everyone's sake.
column2: 指挥官，我不知道出了什么事，但你彻底搞砸了任务，我们没法付你钱。希望这种事再也别发生，为大家好。

column1: The JarnFolk despise you, and I would shoot you myself if you stood before me.  If you want to improve this situation, start by performing this small task for us.
column2: 雅恩族鄙视你，若你站在我面前，我早就亲手开枪了。若你想改善局面，就从为我们完成这桩小任务开始。

column1: You have sent many JarnFolk to Valhalla, including some of my own clan.  Let us end this blood feud; assist us in this task and we will pay you well.
column2: 你送了不少雅恩族去英灵殿，其中还有我本族的同胞。让我们结束这场血仇吧；协助我们完成这项任务，我们会给你丰厚报酬。

column1: Commander, the JarnFolk acknowledge your strength in combat.  Let us turn that to our mutual profit shall we?
column2: 指挥官，雅恩族认可你的战斗实力。不如让我们借此谋取共同的利益，如何？

column1: Welcome Commander.  The JarnFolk are a peaceful agrarian people, however there is a task that someone with your skills could assist us with.
column2: 欢迎，指挥官。雅恩族是爱好和平的农耕民族，不过有一项任务，或许需要你这样的身手来相助。

column1: Greetings my friend.  The blood of our enemies flows freely by your hand, and we have another target for you.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。我们敌人的血在你手下自由流淌，我们还有一个目标给你。

column1: Come, let us discuss the next target we wish you to go a viking against.  Odin will have a place at his table for you my friend!
column2: 来吧，我们谈谈下一个想让你去劫掠的目标。奥丁会为你留一个席位，我的朋友！

column1: You fight with the strength of Thor, Commander!  Well done, payment is being transferred as we speak.
column2: 你以托尔般的力量作战，指挥官！干得好，报酬正在转账。

column1: What sort of whelp are you that runs from battle?  Do you not want to feast in Valhalla?  Begone, before I kill you myself.
column2: 你是什么品种的孬种，竟从战斗中逃跑？你不想在英灵殿赴宴吗？滚远点，趁我还没亲手杀了你。

column1: We have a job for you, Commander. Let's hope you're not as much of a disappointment this time.
column2: 我们有份活儿给你，指挥官。但愿这次你别再那么令人失望。

column1: Even if you only work for profit and salvage, you seem effective enough. The Prefecture has need of your skills, Commander.
column2: 即便你只为报酬与战利品而战，你也算够用了。辖区需要你的本事，指挥官。

column1: The Kittery Prefecture would like to offer you a choice contract, Commander. As the leader of a respected mercenary company, you should find the terms both fair and equitable.
column2: 基特里辖区想向你提供一份精选合约，指挥官。作为一支受尊敬的雇佣兵公司的首领，你应该会觉得条款既公道又公平。

column1: Hello, Commander. We value this relationship, and so we would like to offer you first right of refusal on this contract. The job is simple, and the pay adequate. We know it to be within your capabilities as well.
column2: 你好，指挥官。我们珍视这段关系，因此想给你这份合约的优先拒绝权。活儿简单，报酬也过得去，我们也知道这在你的能力范围内。

column1: Maintaining the Prefecture against its enemies requires warriors of skill and honor, Commander, and you appear to have both.
column2: 指挥官，抵御外敌、维系辖区，需要既有本事又有荣誉的战士，而你似乎两者兼具。

column1: Greetings Commander.  You have proven to be quite a friend to the Prefecture. We have saved this contract as reward for your services.
column2: 您好，指挥官。你已证明自己是辖区的挚友。我们留着这份合约，作为对你效力的奖赏。

column1: Honored friend! The Prefecture has not forgotten your contributions to its continued existance. In light of this, we present you with this choice contract.
column2: 尊敬的朋友！辖区不曾忘记你对其存续所作的贡献。有鉴于此，我们向您奉上这份精选合约。

column1: Excellent work, Commander. You have our gratitude and your reward is on its way.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。我们感激你，你的报酬正在路上。

column1: Commander, we understand the efforts you expended in attempting to achieve the goals of this mission. We're not upset, just disappointed.
column2: 指挥官，我们明白你为达成这次任务目标所付出的努力。我们不是生气，只是失望。

column1: Removing Blakists is even more difficult when we have to hand-hold incompetent merceraries such as you!  Don't fail us again.
column2: 我们还得手把手扶着像你这样的无能雇佣兵，清剿布雷克信徒就更难了！别再让我们失望。

column1: You work for pay, do you not? House Kurita has plenty of money for you, mercenary. Simply be quick and efficient about it—we have little time for your kind.
column2: 你是为钱干活的，对吧？库瑞塔家族有的是钱给你，雇佣兵。只要干得利落高效——我们没工夫应付你这种人。
